verdict.rationale: MotherDuck has a dedicated dbt integration page stating that the dbt-duckdb adapter lets dbt use DuckDB and MotherDuck, and that the only change needed is the `path:` setting in the profile. Its homepage also positions dbt workloads as a standard use case on Standard instances. missing for 10: evidence of who maintains the adapter (first-party vs community), depth of the dbt docs beyond the profile setting (e.g., incremental models, MotherDuck-specific configs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of dbt runs against MotherDuck.
